## Treatments
- [Morpheus8 & Forma](https://beautykarmaskinandlaser.com/morpheus8/): Morpheus8 Burst RF microneedling and Forma skin tightening in St. George & Washington, UT. Tighten loose skin, smooth acne scars and texture with Master Aesthetician Jessica Gubler.
- [Laser Hair Removal](https://beautykarmaskinandlaser.com/laser-hair-removal/): Laser hair removal in St. George & Washington, UT for women and men: underarms, bikini & Brazilian, legs, face, back and chest, with InMode technology and built-in cooling.
- [IPL Photo Facial](https://beautykarmaskinandlaser.com/ipl-photofacial/): IPL photofacial with InMode Lumecca in St. George & Washington, UT: fade sun spots, freckling, redness and broken capillaries on the face, neck, chest and hands.
- [Facials, Peels & Microneedling](https://beautykarmaskinandlaser.com/facials-and-peels/): Custom facials, chemical peels (TCA, Jessner, glycolic, salicylic, lactic, retinol) and microneedling in St. George & Washington, UT with Master Aesthetician Jessica Gubler.

## Common concerns and the treatment for each
- Acne scars: Morpheus8. RF microneedling rebuilds collagen under scars and smooths texture.
- Loose skin: Morpheus8 & Forma. Tighten the jawline, neck and face without surgery.
- Fine lines: Morpheus8 or microneedling. New collagen softens lines from within.
- Sun spots: IPL Photo Facial. Light targets brown spots and freckling so they fade away.
- Redness: IPL Photo Facial. Calms redness and broken capillaries for an even tone.
- Unwanted hair: Laser Hair Removal. Smooth skin for good, face and body, women and men.
- Breakouts: Facial + chemical peel. Clears congestion and calms active breakouts.
- Dull skin: Signature Facial. Deep cleanse, exfoliation and LED for an instant glow.

## Questions clients ask

### Morpheus8 & Forma
- **Does Morpheus8 hurt?** Numbing cream is applied first. Most clients describe a warm, prickly feeling. Jessica will talk you through every step.
- **Is there downtime?** Expect redness for a day or two after Morpheus8, like a mild sunburn. Forma has no downtime.
- **How many treatments will I need?** It depends on your skin and goals. Many people see a change after one Morpheus8 treatment, and a series gives the best results. You'll get a plan at your consultation.
- **What's the aftercare?** No makeup for 24 hours, gentle cleanser and the post-care Jessica sends home with you, no workouts, hot tubs or saunas for 48 hours, and SPF every day.

### Laser Hair Removal
- **How many sessions will I need?** Most people need a series of treatments spaced several weeks apart. Jessica will build a plan for your hair and skin type.
- **Does it hurt?** Most clients describe a quick snap with cooling right after. It's far quicker than waxing.
- **When should I start?** Fall and winter are ideal: less sun on treated skin, and you'll finish your series before swimsuit season.

### IPL Photo Facial
- **Is there downtime?** Very little. Brown spots darken and flake off over about a week. You can wear makeup the next day.
- **When is the best time of year?** IPL works best when you can avoid strong sun right before and after, so fall and winter are ideal here.
- **How many treatments?** Often 2–4 sessions, depending on how much sun damage there is.
- **Can IPL treat melasma?** Melasma usually responds better to a carefully chosen chemical peel. Jessica will recommend the right option at your consultation.

### Facials, Peels & Microneedling
- **Which facial should I book first?** If you're new, start with the Intro Facial or a consultation. Jessica will map out what's next.
- **Do you sell skincare?** Jessica is a SkinCeuticals ambassador and can recommend a simple home routine that fits your skin.
- **Is there a membership?** Yes. Ask about the VIP Membership for savings on regular facials and treatments.
